# Known govulncheck findings accepted as unfixable.
#
# Format: one OSV ID per line, "#" starts a comment, blank lines ignored.
# CI (the security-go job in .github/workflows/ci.yaml) fails if govulncheck
# reports a *reachable* finding whose ID is not listed here -- so adding a line
# here is a deliberate, reviewed risk acceptance, not a silence-all.
#
# This file is intentionally EMPTY as of 2026-10-03.
#
# It previously accepted four findings: GO-2026-4887 and GO-2026-4883
# (github.com/docker/docker), and GO-2026-5004 and GO-2026-4518
# (github.com/jackc/pgx/v4 and its wire layer). The dependency updates in
# v0.1.8-rc1 made all four unreachable, so govulncheck now reports nothing at
# all. The entries were removed rather than left in place: a stale allowlist
# silently accepts a finding that later becomes genuinely reachable, which is
# the opposite of what this gate is for.
#
# If a finding reappears, CI will fail and name it. Confirm it is genuinely
# unfixable before adding it back, and record why in
# docs/DEPENDENCIES.md alongside the entry.
